using System;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync_LogsForegroundCheckpointRetrieval()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var replicationManager = new ReplicationManagerForTest(loggerMock.Object);

            var options = new ReplicateSyncOptions
            {
                NodeId = 1,
                TryAddReplica = false,
                Background = false,
                UpgradeLock = false,
                Force = false
            };

            // Act
            var result = await replicationManager.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(null, options);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Initiating foreground checkpoint retrieval")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // A minimal subclass to expose the method for testing
        private class ReplicationManagerForTest : ReplicationManager
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public ReplicationManagerForTest(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            public new async Task<(bool Success, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> ErrorMessage)> TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(
                ClusterSession session,
                ReplicateSyncOptions options)
            {
                return await base.TryReplicateDiskbasedSyncAsync(session, options);
            }
        }
    }
}
